IS : 8903 ■ 1978 

Indian Standard 

SPECIFICATION FOR 

DRAWBARS FOR TRAILERS OF UP TO 

5 TONNES GROSS MASS 

0. FOREWORD 

0.1 This Indian Standard was adopted by the Indian Standards Institu- 
tion on 31 August 1978, after the draft finalized by the Transport Tractors 
and Trailers Sectional Committee had been approved by the Marine, 
Cargo Movement and Packaging Division Council. 

0.2 This standard, which relates only to the vehicles used on public 
highways, is intended to ensure the maximum degree of compatibility of 
technical requirements and government regulations. 

0*3 The materials specified have been included for their characteristics. 
This does not preclude the rase of any other material having these 
characteristics, at least, equal to those for the material specified. 

0.4 This standard should be used in conjunction with IS : 8298-1976* and 
IS:8752-1978t. 

0.5 This standard applies to drawbars for connection to trailers not 
exceeding 5 tonnes gross mass. The drawbar for connections to trailers up 
to 16 tonnes and up to 35 tonnes gross mass shall be as specified in 
IS: 8274-1976$. 

0.6 In the preparation of this standard, assistance has been derived from 
BS AU 24 : 1964 ' Specification for towing connections for trailers of 2-5 
tonnes gross weight ', issued by the British Standards Institution. 



1. SCOPE 

1.1 This standard specifies the materials for the drawbar and dimensions 



•Specification for towing jaw for use between trailers up to 5 tonnes gross mass and 
transport tractor. 

•("Specification for towing hooks for use between trailers up to 5 tonnes gross mass and 
transport tractor. 

$ Specification for drawbar eyes and forecarriage pins for connection between trailers of 
gross mass above 5 tonnes and up to 35 tonnes and transport tractor. 



IS: 8903 -1978 

for the interchangeability for the drawbar eye and drawbar lug for use 
with trailers up to 5 tonnes gross mass ( gross laden train mass where more 
than one trailer is drawn ). 

2. MATERIALS 

2.1 The drawbar shall be manufactured from Grade C30 of IS : 1875-1971*, 
or any other material having characteristics, at least, equivalent to the 
above material. 

3. DIMENSIONS 

3.1 The dimensions of the drawbar eye and drawbar lug shall be as given 
in Table 1, excepting the case in which the vehicle is not constructed or 
adopted for the carriage of goods and the trailer gross mass ( gross laden 
train mass in case more than one trailer is drawn ) does not exceed 3'5 
tonnes. Dimensions A and B shall be not less than 31 mm and 25 mm 
respectively.

4. DESIGN 



4.1 The drawbar eye specified in this standard shall be used with two or 
four wheel trailers excepting trailers forming part of an articulated vehicle. 

4.2 Drawbar X.ug — Effective means shall be provided to prevent endwise 
movement of the pin. The strength and method of attachment of towing 
lugs shall be consistent with the strength and method of attachment of the 
corresponding towing hooks. 

5. MARKING 

5.1 The drawbars shall be marked at the appropriate place with the 
following words: 

' TO TOW 5 TONNES GROSS ' 

5.2 In addition, the drawbars shall also be marked, at the appropriate 
places, with the following information: 

a) Name or trade-mark of the manufacturer, 

b) Date or year of manufacture, and 

c) The country of manufacture. 

5.2.1 The drawbars may also be marked with the ISI Certification Mark. 

Note — The use of the ISI Certification Mark is governed by the provisions of the 
Indian Standards Institution ( Certification Marks ) Act and the Rules and Regulations 
made thereunder. The ISI Mark on products covered by an Indian Standard 
conveys the assurance that they have been produced to comply with the requirements 
of that standard under a well-defined system of inspection, testing and quality control 
which is devised and supervised by ISI and operated by the producer. ISI marked 
products are also continuously checked by ISI for conformity to that standard as a 
further safeguard. Details of conditions under which a licence for the use of the ISI 
Certification Mark may be granted to manufacturers or processors, may be obtained 
from the Indian Standards Institution.
